workflow.in_use_check: fuser -I; errors or uncertainty block eviction

cases: Complete two-shard copy and SHA256 verification
Zero-copy reuse for existing SSD files
16 GiB reserve plus metadata allowance: one-byte-below rejected and exact boundary accepted
Changed source and destination checksum failure remove only owned partial copies
An earlier source shard changing during a later copy blocks publication
Changed archive originals or staged symlinks block eviction
Explicit unload confirmation and live open-file guard
Unexpected files and path escapes block deletion
Unmarked nonempty directories are not adopted

retained_initial_failure.scope: Small synthetic fixture integration test, not user model data.
retained_initial_failure.reason: The installed fuser did not accept the -- separator as used by the initial helper.
retained_initial_failure.fix: Use supported fuser -I with absolute paths; add a real open-file process test.

limitations: No full-model archive-to-SSD copy was necessary or benchmarked.
Same-filesystem reuse assumes the explicitly selected staging filesystem is the intended working tier.
GGUF filename/count checks and byte hashes do not establish semantic checkpoint correctness.
Free-space checks do not reserve capacity against independent writers.
The unload confirmation and external in-use check are not a universal concurrent inference lease.
This setup does not improve already-cached generation by itself.
